products.short: Plate-loaded lat pulldown station for back training, built for commercial floors.

description: The AFZOX PS Series Wide-Arc Lat Pulldown is a plate-loaded commercial strength station built around a vertical pulling path that loads the lats through a full overhead-to-chest range. It is intended for continuous use on a commercial floor, where the load is set by adding Olympic plates rather than by a stack pin.

Long curved arms sweep through a wide overhead arc above a seat with thigh restraints. Resistance is plate-loaded, so the station reads its load at a glance and scales with whatever plates the floor already carries.
features: Wide bolt-down base with levelling feet
Printed instruction placard on the frame
AFZOX branding on frame and plates
products.primaryApplication: Vertical pull for back strength development.
